Waste Management Phoenix Open Transportation: Party at the 16th Hole

The Waste Management Phoenix Open is the largest attended golf event in the world, with over 700,000 fans during tournament week. Transportation planning is essential.

WM Phoenix Open Transportation Guide

The Waste Management Phoenix Open is the largest attended golf event in the world, with over 700,000 fans during tournament week. Transportation planning is essential.

Why Transportation Matters

  • 700,000+ weekly attendance - Largest golf tournament crowds
  • The 16th Hole - 20,000-seat stadium experience
  • Parking nightmare - Main lots fill before 10 AM on weekends
  • Post-round parties - Old Town Scottsdale goes wild

Tournament Schedule (Typically Late January/Early February)

  • Monday: Pro-Am
  • Tuesday: Practice rounds
  • Wednesday: Practice + AJGA
  • Thursday-Sunday: Main tournament

Transportation Options

Party Bus Package

Best for: Groups wanting full experience

  • Pre-game party en route
  • Drop-off at VIP entrance
  • All-day availability
  • Post-tournament to Old Town
  • $1,200-1,800 (8 hours, 20 passengers)

Sprinter Van Service

Best for: Groups of 8-14

  • Comfortable captain's chairs
  • Cooler for beverages
  • Flexible timing
  • Multiple stop capability
  • $800-1,200 (8 hours)

Executive SUV

Best for: Corporate entertainment

  • Client-ready presentation
  • Privacy for business discussions
  • Premium amenities
  • $600-900 (8 hours)

TPC Scottsdale Logistics

Location

  • North Scottsdale (Hayden & Bell Road)
  • 25 minutes from Old Town Scottsdale
  • 35 minutes from downtown Phoenix
  • 45 minutes from Sky Harbor Airport

Gate Options

  • Main Gate: General admission
  • North Gate: Less crowded, longer walk
  • VIP Entrance: Charter vehicle access

Traffic Patterns

  • Thursday: Moderate
  • Friday: Heavy, especially afternoon
  • Saturday: Extreme - the "party hole" day
  • Sunday: Heavy through awards

Sample Tournament Itinerary

Full Tournament Day (10 hours)

8:00 AM - Hotel pickup
9:00 AM - VIP gate drop-off
9:30 AM - Walk course, morning groups
12:30 PM - Lunch at hospitality area
2:00 PM - 16th Hole stadium experience
5:00 PM - Final groups finish
5:30 PM - Tournament pickup
6:30 PM - Dinner in Old Town
8:30 PM - Nightlife begins
2:00 AM - Return to hotel

Pricing Guide

ServiceWeekdaySaturdaySunday
SUV (6 hrs)$750$900$850
Sprinter (8 hrs)$1,200$1,500$1,400
Party Bus (10 hrs)$2,000$2,500$2,400

Saturday "16th Hole Day" commands premium pricing

Booking Timeline

  • 3+ months ahead: Guaranteed availability, standard pricing
  • 1-2 months: Good selection, 10-15% premium
  • 2-4 weeks: Limited options, 20-30% premium
  • Week of: Emergency rates, very limited

Pro Tips

  1. Saturday is madness - Best for party, worst for actual golf watching
  2. Thursday/Friday - Best for seeing players up close
  3. Dress layers - February mornings are chilly
  4. Bring cash - Vendor lines faster
  5. Wear comfortable shoes - 10,000+ steps typical
